title: Benjamin Franklin and the French Muse lodge

tellings.quote: like Benjamin Franklin did you know that they were actually part of a Mason Lodge that was a muse Lodge

plain: The American founding father Benjamin Franklin is said to have belonged to a lodge of the Freemasons, a secretive fraternal society, in France, and to a special kind of lodge named for the Muses, the Greek goddesses of the arts. The researcher Diana Pasulka mentions it in passing on Michels's show, in a talk about religion and UFOs, without naming where she learned it.
